title: Board envelope and connector mechanics need manufacturer geometry
component_interface: Board A/B stack and board-to-board connector
description: The product leaves board dimensions and connector series open until crib volume and cable routing are provided. Electrical interface classes can be controlled separately.

evidence.note: Dimensions and connector depend on crib-manufacturer geometry and harness route.

closure_criterion: Obtain controlled crib volume, mounting datum, allowable stack height, cable routes and assembly/service constraints; then select and verify keyed connector and board envelopes with contact/current/return budgets before R7 PASS.
